shadows.name: poster-and-viewer
shadows.purpose: Sheets, project cards and the project viewer frame are flat.

shadows.name: outline-control
shadows.purpose: The retained outline Button shadow-xs; not an elevation scale.

motion.name: topic-change
motion.purpose: Hard-swap the selected sheet and return scroll to top instantly; no hero BlurFade.

motion.name: gallery-tilt-bound
motion.purpose: Maximum positive or negative rotation on each axis; only gallery mode, mouse events, hover, fine pointer and no reduced-motion preference.

motion.name: gallery-transform
motion.purpose: Motion-safe gallery transition; leave, cancel or preference changes clear the transform.

motion.name: dialog-state
motion.purpose: Declared dialog primitive state duration with fade/zoom classes, not a topic transition.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none; transition: none; scroll-behavior: auto
motion.purpose: Base-layer declarations; utility-level color transitions may still apply. Dialog animation and gallery tilt have additional explicit reduced-motion opt-outs.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Main padding, two-column gallery, viewer width/type and larger row thumbnails; biography remains single-column.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Main sheet plus sticky topic rail; topic descriptions become visible.

breakpoints.name: notebook-topics-only
breakpoints.purpose: Retained notebook preview topic links become three columns; not a main-site breakpoint.

layout.topicGrid: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)) below 1024px; one column from 1024px
layout.viewerBody: overflow-y: auto; overscroll-behavior: contain; scrollbar-gutter: stable

focus.viewerButton: 3px half-opacity project-action ring with inherited base offset treatment

notebook.status: Intentionally retained comparison direction, not main-site drift.

editorial.status: Intentionally retained forest/Prata comparison direction with Manrope prose and attributed mountain imagery.

poster.status: Retained selected-world comparison; shares main palette/type but is not the main application's full project viewer.

development.choiceAuthority: User selected poster in the local native direction board after rejecting FRAME.
development.reviewDisposition: Fresh visual review: ship; independent behavior review: no material findings (parent-provided review results).
development.detectorDisposition: Only stale-documentation warnings: Prata/Unbounded and preview-local 15px / 1.75rem sizes. Documented scopes; no source changes warranted.
development.documentationVerification: Source extraction and existing image/evidence inspection only; no build, test, lint, formatter or browser run in this documentation pass.
limits: No invented tonal ramps: the source defines flat colors, not an eight-step scale.
Component snippets are literal CSS visual specimens, not React behavior replicas; application focus restoration, sheet selection and pointer tracking remain in source.
Font families use fallbacks if the host has not loaded the project's locally hosted fonts.
Primitives are owned by DESIGN.md frontmatter; this sidecar has no legacy tokens bag.
No input/form, portrait or certificate specimens: none exist on the main site.

projectViewerThemes.scope: Only the project viewer; poster sheets and screenshot pixels unchanged.
projectViewerThemes.transition: Immediate frame color change; Tailwind @theme is non-inline for inherited semantic overrides.

narrative.overview:
A personal poster wall: bold lettering and whole colored sheets make the person memorable, while generous leading keeps his story easy to read. Solid ink-like colors, square edges and direct topic selection replace the rejected FRAME world; this is not a light recoloring of the old résumé-style composition.

The identity is personal, candid and readable, not recruiting or service sales. Real project screenshots support the story without becoming a substitute portrait. No portrait or certificate material has been supplied, so neither is fabricated or represented by decorative placeholders.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque oxblood, mustard and moss sheets on a slate surround, with cream reading text.
Unbounded display lettering paired with Manrope prose; mono only for viewer position.
Square, flat poster geometry with explicit selection and visible keyboard focus.
Immediate topic changes; motion is optional and confined to bounded gallery response.

rules.name: The Whole Sheet Rule
rules.body: Preserve the oxblood/cream, mustard/oxblood and moss/cream pairings; do not add translucent main reading surfaces or recolor project captures to fit them.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use Unbounded for the main poster's display hierarchy and Manrope for reading and controls; keep IBM Plex Mono confined to viewer position and Prata confined to retained alternatives.

dos: Do keep the person and truthful biography ahead of supporting project evidence.
Do preserve opaque sheet pairings, square poster geometry and readable bilingual reflow down to 320px.
Do show selected state in text or underline as well as color, with visible keyboard focus and 44px control targets.
Do preserve original screenshot colors, source attribution, sample-data disclosure and team credit.
Do retain all three comparison previews with their explicitly scoped alternative palettes and typography.
donts: Don't restore FRAME colors, its rounded exhibit geometry or the hero BlurFade.
Don't mix Prata, notebook blue or editorial forest into the main poster identity.
Don't invent biography, credentials, portraits, contact details, results or service/recruiting claims.
Don't require hover or motion to read content, select topics or open projects.
Don't treat the preview-local 15px and 1.75rem sizes as main-site drift or fabricate unused inputs and tonal ramps.
